thesis: TSM's financial quality, analyst support, and positive medium-term trend provide the strongest buy setup in this batch, subject to continued earnings execution.
strongest_counterexample: A failure to meet forward earnings expectations could trigger both earnings revisions and valuation compression despite the current technical strength.
invalidation_conditions: Material deterioration in margins or free cash flow
Price falling below the 200-day moving average
Forward earnings estimates being revised materially lower
decisive_factors: Price above all three major moving averages
source_note: Fresh Layer 1 data plus current-session English research-only analysis. Portfolio and Layer 5 are excluded.
